name.description: Human-readable display name of the tool

description.description: Detailed explanation of the tool's functionality and purpose

slug.description: Unique identifier of the parent toolkit

name.description: Human-readable name of the parent toolkit

logo.description: URL to the toolkit logo image

input_parameters.description: Schema definition of required input parameters for the tool

no_auth.description: Indicates if the tool can be used without authentication

available_versions.description: List of all available versions for this tool

output_parameters.description: Schema definition of return values from the tool

scope_requirements.description: Structured scope requirements for the tool. Null means the tool is legacy and only exposes flat scopes.

tags.description: List of tags associated with the tool for categorization and filtering

human_description.description: Human-friendly description of the tool, if available

is_deprecated.description: Indicates if this tool is deprecated and may be removed in the future

version.description: Current version identifier of the tool

is_composio_managed.description: Whether this is a Composio-managed auth config

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of available tools with comprehensive filtering, sorting and search capabilities. Use query parameters to narrow down results by toolkit, tags, or search terms.

parameters.description: The slug of the toolkit to filter by
parameters.name: toolkit_slug

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of specific tool slugs to retrieve (overrides other filters)
parameters.name: tool_slugs

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of auth config IDs to filter tools by
parameters.name: auth_config_ids

parameters.description: Filter to only show important/featured tools (set to "true" to enable)
parameters.name: important

parameters.description: Filter tools by one or more tags (can be specified multiple times)
parameters.name: tags

schema.description: Filter tools by one or more scopes (can be specified multiple times)

parameters.description: Array of scopes to filter tools by)
parameters.name: scopes

parameters.description: Full-text search query to filter tools by name, slug, or description. Applied as a soft filter on top of other filters.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Deprecated: use "query" instead. Free-text search query to find tools by name, description, or functionality.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Include deprecated tools in the response
parameters.name: include_deprecated

oneOf.description: Object representation of parsed bracket notation

parameters.description: Toolkit version specification. Use "latest" for latest versions or bracket notation for specific versions per toolkit.
parameters.name: toolkit_versions

parameters.description: Number of items per page, max allowed is 1000
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Cursor for pagination. The cursor is a base64 encoded string of the page and limit. The page is the page number and the limit is the number of items per page. The cursor is used to paginate through the items. The cursor is not required for the first page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: Successfully retrieved tools list with pagination information

401.description: Unauthorized - Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: Forbidden - User does not have permission to access tools

404.description: Not found - The requested resource was not found

429.description: Too many requests - Rate limit exceeded

500.description: Internal server error - Something went wrong on the server

get.description: Retrieve a list of all available tool enumeration values (tool slugs) from latest version of each toolkit. This endpoint returns a comma-separated string of tool slugs that can be used in other API calls.

schema.description: JSON string containing all tool enum values from latest version of each toolkit

401.description: Unauthorized - Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: Forbidden - User does not have permission to access tool enums

404.description: Not found - Tool enum list not found

500.description: Internal server error - Something went wrong on the server

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific tool using its slug identifier. This endpoint returns full metadata about a tool including input/output parameters, versions, and toolkit information.

parameters.description: The unique slug identifier of the tool
parameters.name: tool_slug

parameters.description: Optional version of the tool to retrieve
parameters.name: version

oneOf.description: Object representation of parsed bracket notation

parameters.description: Toolkit version specification. Use "latest" for latest versions or bracket notation for specific versions per toolkit.
parameters.name: toolkit_versions

400.description: Bad request - Invalid tool slug format

401.description: Unauthorized - Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

404.description: Not found - Tool with the specified slug does not exist

500.description: Internal server error - Something went wrong on the server

post.description: Execute a specific tool operation with provided arguments and authentication. This is the primary endpoint for integrating with third-party services and executing tools. You can provide structured arguments or use natural language processing by providing a text description of what you want to accomplish.

schema.description: JSON object containing custom headers to pass to LLM providers (OpenAI, Bedrock, etc.)

connected_account_id.description: Unique identifier for the connected account to use for authentication

entity_id.description: Deprecated: please use user_id instead. Entity identifier for multi-entity connected accounts (e.g. multiple repositories, organizations)

user_id.description: User id for multi-user connected accounts (e.g. multiple users, organizations)

version.description: Tool version to execute (defaults to "00000000_00" if not specified)

base_url.description: The base URL (root address) what you should use while making http requests to the connected account. For example, for gmail, it would be 'https://gmail.googleapis.com'

name.description: The name of the parameter. For example, 'x-api-key', 'Content-Type', etc.

in.description: The location of the parameter. Can be 'query' or 'header'.

value.description: The value of the parameter. For example, '1234567890', 'application/json', etc.

body.description: The body to be sent to the endpoint for authentication. This is a JSON object. Note: This is very rarely needed and is only required by very few apps.

custom_auth_params.description: Custom authentication parameters for tools that support parameterized authentication

custom_connection_data.description: Custom connection data for tools that support custom connection data

state_prefix.description: The oauth2 state prefix for the connection

long_redirect_url.description: Whether to return the redirect url without shortening

arguments.description: Key-value pairs of arguments required by the tool (mutually exclusive with text)

text.description: Natural language description of the task to perform (mutually exclusive with arguments)
text.example: Trigger the main workflow in the octocat/Hello-World repository on the main branch for the production environment

allow_tracing.description: Deprecated. Enable debug tracing for tool execution (useful for debugging)

200.description: Successfully executed action and received response

data.description: Tool execution output data that varies based on the specific tool

error.description: Error message if the tool execution was not successful (null if successful)

successful.description: Indicates if the tool execution was successful

session_info.description: Optional session information for tools that return session context

log_id.description: Unique identifier for the execution log (useful for debugging and support)

400.description: Bad request - Invalid request parameters, missing required arguments, or conflicting parameters

401.description: Unauthorized - Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: Forbidden - Connected account does not have permission to execute this tool or access the requested resource

404.description: Not found - Tool or connected account not found

408.description: Request timeout - Tool execution exceeded the maximum allowed time

410.description: Gone - Tool has been deprecated and is no longer available

413.description: Payload too large - Request or response payload exceeds size limits

422.description: Unprocessable entity - Invalid state of the connected account

429.description: Rate limit exceeded - Too many requests to the tool or underlying API

500.description: Internal server error - Something went wrong on the server

502.description: Bad gateway - Error communicating with the tool provider API

503.description: Upstream service unavailable - Tool provider API is currently down or unavailable

post.summary: Generate tool inputs from natural language
post.description: Uses AI to translate a natural language description into structured arguments for a specific tool. This endpoint is useful when you want to let users describe what they want to do in plain language instead of providing structured parameters.

parameters.description: The tool slug to generate inputs for
parameters.name: tool_slug

text.description: Natural language description of what you want to accomplish with this tool
text.example: I need to trigger the main workflow in the octocat/Hello-World repository to deploy to production

custom_description.description: Custom description of the tool to help guide the LLM in generating more accurate inputs
custom_description.example: This tool triggers GitHub Actions workflows in a repository. It requires the repository name, workflow ID, and optional input parameters.

system_prompt.description: System prompt to control and guide the behavior of the LLM when generating inputs
system_prompt.example: You are an expert assistant that generates precise GitHub Actions workflow parameters. Extract exact repository names, workflow IDs, and input values from user descriptions.

version.description: Tool version to use when generating inputs (defaults to "latest" if not specified)

200.description: Successfully generated structured inputs for the action based on natural language description

arguments.description: Key-value pairs of arguments required by the tool to accomplish the described task

error.description: Error message if the arguments could not be generated (null if successful)
error.example: Unable to determine the repository name from the provided description

400.description: Bad request - Invalid input parameters or insufficient description to generate tool arguments

401.description: Unauthorized - Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

404.description: Not found - The specified tool does not exist

422.description: Unprocessable entity - Invalid state of the connected account

429.description: Too many requests - Rate limit exceeded for natural language processing

500.description: Internal server error - AI processing failed or other server error occurred

post.description: Resolves required scopes for the specified tools at a given toolkit version. All requested tools must belong to the same toolkit. Returns the flat scope union plus per-tool structured scope requirements when available.

tools.description: Tool slugs to resolve scopes for. All tools must belong to the same toolkit.

version.description: Toolkit version to resolve scopes against for the requested toolkit. Defaults to the pinned HTTP version when omitted.

200.description: Successfully retrieved scopes for the specified tools

scopes_required.description: A combined list of all unique scopes required by the specified tools

per_tool_requirements.description: Per-tool structured scope requirements. Null scope_requirements marks unmigrated legacy tools.

400.description: Bad request - Invalid body parameters or tools from different toolkits

401.description: Unauthorized - Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

404.description: Not found - One or more tools could not be resolved for the requested version

500.description: Internal server error - Something went wrong on the server
